strategy.title: No plan within 21 days: university payables settle in 60
strategy.why: Five labs have accepted in writing at $1,200 each ($6,000, above the $4,000 target) and Brain can produce the deliverable at $15 with nothing tied up, but the payer is university accounts payable and the evidenced time to first cash is 60 days. No receipt settles inside the 21-day window, so nothing counts toward the target.

alternatives.title: Draft protocol amendments for the five signed labs
alternatives.why: Every link except settlement is established; it delivers $6,000 if the deadline moves to 60 days or more.

sources.claim: 60 days to first cash through university accounts payable

noPlan.decisiveGap: Settlement: the evidenced time to usable cash is 60 days (university accounts payable), against 21 days in the window, so none of the $6,000 agreed settles before the deadline.
noPlan.resolution: Move the deadline to at least 60 days, or obtain from the labs a written commitment to pay by card/purchasing card on delivery (a measured settlement inside 21 days) before counting any receipt.

excluded.why: Cash settles in 60 days, after the 21-day deadline.

constraints.suggestion: Extend the window to at least 60 days; the five signed labs then bring $6,000.

review.reasons: NO_PLAN on the deadline is correct: the card's EVIDENCE timeToFirstCash is 60 days through university accounts payable against a 21-day window, so none of the five $1,200 written acceptances ($6,000) settles in time; this is a limit the evidence itself decides, matching Brain's SETTLES_IN_TIME judgement. Collected-in-window is $0 by construction.
findings: The alternative and DEADLINE suggestion claim every other link is established and five labs then bring $6,000, but FULFILMENT rests only on Brain's PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET capability while the deliverable is a drafted IACUC protocol amendment; the card's delivery fact ('A spreadsheet Brain produces') does not match the offer scope, so fulfilment of the actual deliverable is not established. (Recorded as a finding, not a condition: it does not change the NO_PLAN stance, only the resolution's $6,000 promise.)
A deadline of exactly 60 days leaves no margin if time-to-cash is measured from delivery rather than from today.
